name: Brewer's Cottage - Red Hill Brewery
address: 88 Shoreham Rd, Red Hill South VIC 3937
signature: A three-bedroom cottage on the Red Hill Brewery grounds. The operator says short stays are unavailable during 2026.
editorNote:
Brewer's Cottage is a self-contained three-bedroom house on the Red Hill Brewery property. The operator currently says the cottage is closed for short stays because it is rented for 2026. Do not plan or attempt to book a short stay there this year. This is a cottage availability update only; it does not describe the brewery's trading status or the cottage's availability after 2026.

The property has a kitchen, open fire and outdoor space. Brewery public opening days can affect privacy, while production and office work occur on weekdays. This detail page is preserved for reference while short stays are unavailable. Check the operator page for any later change.
whyWeGo: The cottage is not available for short stays during 2026; this listing is retained so readers can see the operator's current notice.
